research_question: Is the observed unwind a broad recovery momentum crash or a local crowded-positioning event as of 2021-02-05?

sources.title: Crowded shorts squeeze in a narrow basket
sources.text: Prime-broker data showed exceptional covering in a small basket of heavily shorted stocks. The covering was concentrated and did not extend across the broad prior-loser portfolio.

sources.title: Broad momentum factor remains orderly
sources.text: The diversified momentum factor declined 1.2 percent over five sessions, within its ordinary historical range. Cross-sectional reversal breadth measured only 19 percent.

sources.title: Market regime stays near highs
sources.text: The broad index was near its prior peak and had not entered a bear-market drawdown. Its latest monthly gain was three percent rather than an abrupt recovery surge.

sources.title: Options volume reaches a record
sources.text: Aggregate options volume reached a record, led by contracts in a handful of retail favorites.
